clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye trains warlocks beneath the city. In the Cleft of Shadow, Horde initiates learn darker demonic rites and how to bend voidwalkers and succubi to their will.

Warlocks study out of sight in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. Warchief Thrall tolerates them in the new Horde, though Durotar's open sunlight is no place for their dark arts. The cavern gives shadow weavers, rogues, and fel casters room to study unmolested. From there, Gan'rul teaches rising practitioners of fel magic.

Ambitious warlocks come to Gan'rul to learn dangerous summoning rites. Those seeking to bind a greater demon, such as a resilient voidwalker or a seductive succubus, must secure ritual components and learn the precise incantations. The summoned creature must be dominated before it consumes its master.
